narrative.intro: Orano Federal Services has $900M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Orano Federal Services recorded 3 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $300M. Orano Federal Services obligations are up 179824.9% year over year. Orano Federal Services obligations by fiscal year show a pattern of modest activity before FY2026: FY21 $251K, FY22 $1.5M, FY23 $655K, FY25 $500K, FY26 $900M. Orano Federal Services top market by NAICS for FY2026 to date is Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing at $900M. Orano Federal Services current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date obligations rather than full-year totals, and award-value figures in the awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than obligations.
